strength.title: Strength
strength.beginnerTip: Strength matters most for characters who fight up close with heavy weapons or do a lot of climbing, lifting, or grappling.

dexterity.title: Dexterity
dexterity.beginnerTip: Dexterity helps you act earlier in combat and avoid getting hit. It is one of the most broadly useful abilities in the game.

constitution.title: Constitution
constitution.beginnerTip: Constitution is the stat that keeps you alive longer. If you want your character to survive hard fights, do not neglect it.

intelligence.title: Intelligence
intelligence.summary: Measures reasoning, memory, and learned knowledge.
intelligence.beginnerTip: Intelligence is great for scholarly or investigative characters, but many builds can function fine without it.

wisdom.title: Wisdom
wisdom.beginnerTip: Wisdom is one of the most important abilities for noticing danger and resisting mental tricks.

charisma.title: Charisma
charisma.summary: Measures force of personality, confidence, and presence.
charisma.beginnerTip: Charisma is important if your character talks a lot, leads the group, or casts spells using force of personality.
